name: keyhead_walnut_1
prompt: This is an upscaled crop of a photoreal audio-plugin UI. Output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, with EXACTLY the same framing, scale, perspective, lighting, colours and every detail as the input, so it overlays the input pixel for pixel. Where the old keyhead was bigger, show the instrument's own top surface. Everything outside that change must stay identical to the input.
